arguments.value: Persistent pruritic Blaschkoid erythematous to violaceous scaly papules and plaques on the right trunk and right upper extremity began 1 month after shingles vaccination, with biopsy findings supporting inflammatory linear verrucous epidermal nevus. The eruption was refractory to multiple topical anti-inflammatory treatments and excimer laser, but improved rapidly and durably with intralesional triamcinolone injections, with only a mild recurrence that responded to repeat treatment.
